<<<POU name=EdgeDetect kind=function_block>>>
FUNCTION_BLOCK EdgeDetect
VAR_INPUT
    value : DWORD;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    hasChanged : BOOL;
    hasRisingEdges : BOOL;
    risingBits : DWORD;
    noOfRisingBits : USINT;
    hasFallingEdges : BOOL;
    fallingBits : DWORD;
    noOfFallingBits : USINT;
END_VAR
VAR
    prev : DWORD;
    i : INT;
    mask : DWORD;
END_VAR
<<<IMPL>>>
risingBits := 0;
fallingBits := 0;
noOfRisingBits := 0;
noOfFallingBits := 0;
hasRisingEdges := FALSE;
hasFallingEdges := FALSE;
FOR i := 0 TO 31 DO
    mask := SHL(DWORD#1, i);
    IF ((value AND mask) <> 0) AND ((prev AND mask) = 0) THEN
        risingBits := risingBits OR mask;
        noOfRisingBits := noOfRisingBits + 1;
        hasRisingEdges := TRUE;
    ELSIF ((value AND mask) = 0) AND ((prev AND mask) <> 0) THEN
        fallingBits := fallingBits OR mask;
        noOfFallingBits := noOfFallingBits + 1;
        hasFallingEdges := TRUE;
    END_IF
END_FOR
hasChanged := (value <> prev);
prev := value;
<<<END>>>
